name: Satomi Akira
source: Because of his parents' circumstances, Akira had to move during the summer vacation, hence he has no friends in the new town. One day, he sneaks into a large mansion found by exploring the town and encounters the girl, Kasumi, who is living there. She become's Akira's first friend in the new town.
